title: image.json
description: The brief for a single-image post. Field names follow cards.json so the same render engine can read it as a one-card deck.

campagne.description: A short slug for the piece.

texte.description: Optional. At most two short sentences, twenty words each, subject first.

source.description: Short, identifiable source. Required when texte is present.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for someone who cannot see it. No 'image of'.

identite.description: One sentence on what the image shows, without naming its author or licence.
